proof_body:
by
  intro R ι _ s F P hs h1 h2
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs
  refine ⟨Ideal.isPrimary_finsetInf hi h1 (fun y hy => by rw [h2 y hy, h2 i hi]), ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ t : Finset ι, t.Nonempty → (∀ i ∈ t, (F i).radical = P) → (t.inf F).radical = P := by
    intro t ht
    induction ht using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
    | singleton a => intro h; simpa using h a (by simp)
    | cons a t ha ht ih =>
      intro h
      rw [Finset.cons_eq_insert, Finset.inf_insert, Ideal.radical_inf, h a (by simp), ih (fun j hj => h j (by simp [hj]))]
      simp
  exact key s ⟨i, hi⟩ h2
target_source: ∀ (R ι : Type*) [CommRing R] (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Ideal R) (P : Ideal R), s.Nonempty → (∀ i ∈ s, (F i).IsPrimary) → (∀ i ∈ s, (F i).radical = P) → (s.inf F).IsPrimary ∧ (s.inf F).radical = P
